thread:
hugo-infra: hitting quota errors when provisioning Dedicated nodes in eu-north1 for the new tenancy — attempted to spin up 4 A100s, gcloud returns QUOTA_EXCEEDED for GPUs and vCPUs.

maria-cloud: can you paste the exact error? and which billing/project id?

hugo-infra: error: "Quota 'GPUS_ALL_REGIONS' exceeded. Requested 4, available 0." plus "Quota 'CPUS' exceeded in region eu-north1." Project: redwood-dedicated-eun. Billing acct: 0123-4567-8901. Trying: `gcloud compute instances create rwd-ded-01 --zone=europe-north1-a --machine-type=n1-highmem-32 --accelerator=type=nvidia-a100,count=1` repeated 4x.

jamie-eng: @maria-cloud we set a dedicated plan for this tenant starting next month; they need a temporary burst this week to run a late migration test. what's the quickest path?

maria-cloud: opened support case with GCP, asked for region-level GPU quota increase and vCPU bump. They requested expected sustained usage, IP range, and PO if we need >30 days. Case reference: 9876543210.

aws-support-bot: GCP case 9876543210 created. Agent assigned: A. Halderson (Tier2). ETA initial response: 4 business hours.

daniel-sre: forwarding our quota justification: 4x A100 (40GB) for 72 hours as a temporary burst, then 12 A100 sustained across two zones for production (starting MM/DD). Also we need 256 vCPUs region quota. Can someone paste the compliance doc and the estimated monthly cost?

hugo-infra: pasted cost rough calc: 4 A100 preemptible-ish test: ~$1,200/hr; sustained 12 A100 on Dedicated reserved pricing would be quoted — finance is on standby.

maria-cloud: GCP asked for a JSON usage plan + list of instance names and zones; they want project owner contact and a billing verification document. I've attached the billing contact email in the case. I also asked for a temporary 14-day window for the burst to avoid PO delays.

jamie-eng: thumbs up. can we supply instance names: rwd-ded-test-1..4 in europe-north1-a/b. Provide service account id: 123456789-compute@developer.gserviceaccount.com.

hugo-infra: added that to the case. Also flagged this as business-impact: migration smoke tests blocked.

aws-support-bot: Update from GCP agent: "We can approve a temporary quota increase for GPUs for 14 days pending billing verification. Please upload an invoice or PO. For a sustained increase, submit a signed request from billing owner." Agent notes: escalation to quota team started.

daniel-sre: can finance produce an interim letter of commitment? that should satisfy them for the 14-day window.

maria-cloud: finance can provide a signed letter. i'm attaching it to the case now and requesting an immediate lift.

hugo-infra: quick note: after successful create, please validate our SG and routing — we hit a networking error last time where the NVLink overlay failed in zone-b. keep an eye on `dmesg` VM logs for nvidia driver complaints.

jamie-eng: noted. i'll run a small smoke script post-provision: `while sleep 10; do nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,utilization.gpu --format=csv; done` and a perf job to validate latency.

aws-support-bot: Case 9876543210 updated: quota team approved temporary increase (4 GPUs, +256 vCPUs) for 14 days. Support asks to confirm when you've used the burst so they can monitor. Follow-up: open a separate sustained request with billing PO for long-term.

hugo-infra: K, spinning up now. will report back within 30m. :rocket: 

jamie-eng: thanks — ping here if any driver/kernel nonsense.

last message: hugo-infra: provisioning succeeded, all 4 A100s are up in europe-north1-a/b. ran nvidia-smi check and health probes passed. tagging case 9876543210 resolved for temporary burst; opened new case 9876543211 for sustained quota with PO attached.
